note: Authority Twitter/X posts — summarized with link. Verify on original tweet; not official confirmation.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted a press release regarding identification of mortal remains of victims of the recent flash flood in Nepal, including a link to the document and tagging @MEAIndia @IndianDiplomacy @navsri6619. The tweet itself provides no confirmation of any identifications.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted a press release link about identification of mortal remains from the recent flash flood in Nepal, tagging @MEAIndia and others. This sharing does not constitute official confirmation of any identifications.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia directed readers to a press release from its Embassy in Nepal on identification of mortal remains of victims of the recent flash flood there, without issuing any official confirmation. The post contains only a link and no further details.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal shared a press briefing note stating that 626 bodies have been recovered in the Bhote Koshi Flood so far, about 2400 people remain unaccounted for, and over 4450 people (including over 187 foreign nationals) have been rescued, with search and verification ongoing and figures subject to change.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia stated that a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the flash flood-affected area to facilitate search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal retweeted @TravelGov stating that search and rescue operations continue following the severe August 26 flood in Rasuwa District, with a lake that formed ups… This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal states that Nepal’s Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal held a telephone conversation today with China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi. No further details or outcomes are provided in the post.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu continues engaging Nepali authorities on search-and-rescue for Indian nationals affected by the flash flood, and that its First Secretary (Commerce) met recently rescued Indian workers today. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal stated that today a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the flash flood-affected area, which will help facilitate early search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not presented as official confirmation.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal states that the Embassy of India in Kathmandu continues to engage with Nepali authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals impacted by the flash flood. It also notes that the First Secretary (Commerce) @IndiaInNepal met some recently rescued Indian workers.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal states that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu continues to engage with Nepali authorities on search and rescue of Indian nationals impacted by the flash flood, and that its First Secretary (Commerce) met some recently rescued Indian workers. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal reports that a specialized technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the flash flood-affected area today, which will help facilitate early search and rescue of stranded individuals. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal stated that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs organized a press briefing today by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal on the Government’s ongoing search, rescue and relief efforts following the devastating floods in the Bhote Koshi River. The briefing concluded with an attachment or link.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted a message directing users to a Nepal Police link for details on unidentified bodies recovered in connection with the floods in Rasuwa District. The tweet provides no official confirmation or additional information.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal reports continued search, rescue, and recovery operations in Rasuwa District and communities along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers through Mugling following the severe August 26 flood, noting ongoing flood risk and travel disruptions as of August 29, 2026. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal reports flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, with 538 bodies recovered and 511 of 632 people from 33 countries still missing while search and rescue continues. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal reported that the United States is delivering supplies requested by Nepal’s government and coordinating to get assistance to those who need it, noting that Chargé d’Affaires Scott Urbom sent the first shipment of emergency supplies today. This is not presented as official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted daily updates on foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood, with the post timestamped at 15:00 hrs NST on 28 August 2026 and links to further details. This does not constitute official confirmation of any specific information.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States is delivering a range of supplies requested by the Government of Nepal and working with Nepal to ensure assistance reaches those who need it. The tweet adds that today Chargé d’Affaires Scott Urbom sent the first shipment of emergency supplies.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal retweeted @MEAIndia with an update on Indian nationals rescued in Nepal, including the names of 63 working at the Trishuli-I project. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for assistance regarding foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood, including two links. The tweet does not confirm any details of the incident.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Response Team for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood, along with two links. This does not constitute official confirmation of any events.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia posted an update listing the names of 63 Indian nationals working at the Trishuli-I project in Nepal who have been rescued, with further details linked. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal posted a notice about an Emergency Control Room (ECR) for foreign nationals affected by the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa, with hotline/WhatsApp numbers +977-9744441227 and +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm), email emergency@mofa.gov.np, and updates at mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal reported that Hon. Minister Shisir Khanal received a call from US Under Secretary Allison Hooker @UnderSecStateP, during which she conveyed US Government condolences. The tweet cuts off without specifying the subject.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: @MEAIndia posted about a Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation, listing contact numbers (+91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719), WhatsApp (+91-9968291988), and email (situationroom@mea.gov.in) for families of Indian nationals. This is not official confirmation of events.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal posted about Rasuwa flooding and major road closures, stating that on August 26 a catastrophic flash flood and debris flow struck Rasuwagadhi, Timure, Syafrubesi, and downstream communities in Rasuwa District and along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani river corridors. This is not official confirmation.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal states that rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood are published on the NDRRMA rescue portal and SETU platform. Families are advised to use the official channels at ndrrma.gov.np/np/rescue and setu.ndrrma.gov.np.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ states that Nepal Police Unified Database (UDB) publishes official found, missing, and unidentified remains lists for flood-affected areas at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np and advises against relying on unofficial social media posts.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal posted emergency helpline numbers for contacting the Embassy of India in Kathmandu: +977 985 131 6807, +977 970 910 7500, and +977 981 032 6117 (also reachable via WhatsApp). This is not official confirmation of any event.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the flash floods in Nepal’s Rasuwa district, adding that thoughts are with all those affected. The post does not provide official confirmation of any details.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated that the United States extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the flash floods in Nepal’s Rasuwa district, with thoughts also with all those affected. The post does not provide official confirmation of events.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: @IndiainNepal states that the Embassy of India, Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area and directs people to contact the MEA control room or Embassy for assistance.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal retweeted @State_SCA, which stated that U.S. citizens needing urgent assistance related to the Rasuwa flooding should call the U.S. Embassy at +977-1-423-4000. This is not official confirmation of any event.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal states that Nepali authorities report severe flooding in Rasuwa and have issued warnings for communities along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani rivers. The tweet advises U.S. citizens in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, and Tanahun to stay away from riverbanks and low-lying areas.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal stated it is deeply saddened by the tragic loss of life and devastation from the Bhote Koshi flood that struck Rasuwa district and communities downstream, and extended condolences to the families of those who lost their lives. This is not presented as official confirmation of events.
